Advertisement for Security Officer and Clerks
Wednesday, 04 April 2018
6392 Hits
Secretary, Kasturba Health Society Sevagram invites applications for the post of clerk and Security Officer. The applications on plain paper enclosed with the certified photocopies of the educational qualification and experience must reach to the Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Po. Sevagram, Dist. Wardha 442 102 latest by
20 th April 2018
. Candidates must have to submit copy of registration with Employment Exchange. Candidates belonging to Reserve Category should submit copy of Caste and Validity certificate.
Lower Division Clerk/ Data Entry Operator (3 posts - 1 SC, 1 ST, 1 Open) –
Qualification & Experience - Graduate from a recognized University, proficiency in operating computers, MSCIT, Typing 40 WPM English, Typing 30 WPM Marathi/Hindi with one year experience.
Security Supervisor (4 posts – 1 SC, 1 ST, 2 Open)
Qualification & Experience – HSSC, security related experience of five years in a big organization. Those who have worked in a 300 or more beded hospital and Ex-service man will be preferred
Salary
: As admissible under the rules of Kasturba Health Society
Age Limit
: Between 18 to 35 years
Note:
1. Suitable & experienced candidates can be considered for relaxation in age limit.
2. Decision of Selection Committee will be final.
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
